'''Balmorran Arms''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer based on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It was responsible for manufacturing the [[SD-series battle droid/Legends|SD-series battle droid]] and the [[X-1 Viper]].

==History==
[[File:Balmorran_Arms_Factory.png|left|thumb|[[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on Balmorra]]
Prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company's [[Technology Lead]], [[Hoipa Vonill]] announced a partnership with the [[Melody Fellowship]] for whom Balmorran Arms designed the [[RO-D-series droid]].

After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-allied [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] seized control of Balmorran Arms and used it to manufacture [[SD-6 Hulk infantry droid]]s. Under [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Hinch Beltane]] ran the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and also oversaw production of Balmorran Arms which churned out the majority of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] in use by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. However, the Balmorrans longed for independence from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], wishing for a free market to sell their renowned weapons technology on.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Balmorran Arms was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], allowing it to remain independent for five [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the company also supplied [[SD-9 battle droid|SD-9-series battle droids]] to the New Republic in limited numbers. However, during the reborn Emperor Palpatine's [[Operation Shadow Hand|insurrection]], Balmorran Arms was brought back into Imperial service. However, following Palpatine's [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|supposed death]] near [[Da Soocha V]], the rebellious Balmorrans rebelled against the Empire.

In retaliation, the planet was attacked by a force under the command of [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]], including [[Shadow Droid]]s and SD-9 battle droids. After suffering [[Battle of Balmorra|surprising losses]] at the hands of the [[SD-10 battle droid]]s and new [[X-1 Viper|Viper Automatons]], Sedriss called off his attack in exchange for a shipment of the [[Molecular shielding|molecularly-shielded]] droids.
